from.place: proof, the preliminary fact needed to apply fpqc descent: the structure morphism Spec(K) -> Spec(k) is surjective

title: A field extension induces a surjective morphism of spectra
statement: Let $k\subseteq K$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. The structure morphism $p:\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism].

source.place: Algebra, the spectrum of a field has one point; the induced map for a field extension is surjective
